customer_reply:
Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We take data exposure very seriously. Our security team will investigate immediately. In the meantime, please ensure that all participants are logged in with their correct credentials and that no shared screens are used during auctions. We will keep you updated on the findings and any actions required.

If you notice any further incidents or have additional details, let us know right away.
